english.note: Use 點 when a numeric time is being read as a clock time in ordinary speech rather than as strict formal military notation.

exampleSentences.english: The meeting starts at eight thirty in the morning and lasts an hour.
exampleSentences.traditional: 個會朝早八點三十分開始，做一個鐘。
